title: S1 Practice Quiz 1: Add & Subtract Focus
subtitle: Standards S1.a & S1.b · 7 Questions · ~30 min
purpose: Practice quiz targeting Kai's weakness: negative sign distribution in polynomial subtraction. 5 S1.a questions (2 targeting the Q3 pattern), 2 S1.b to keep multiply sharp.

questions.question_html:
Subtract the polynomials. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (4x^2 - 3x + 7) - (2x^2 - 5x + 3) \)
questions.hint: Distribute the negative to every term in the second polynomial: -(2x^2 - 5x + 3) = -2x^2 + 5x - 3.

questions.question_html:
Subtract. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (2x^3 - x^2 + 4) - (x^3 + 3x^2 - 2x + 1) \)
questions.hint: Flip the sign on every term being subtracted: -(x^3 + 3x^2 - 2x + 1) = -x^3 - 3x^2 + 2x - 1.

questions.question_html:
Let \( f(x) = 5x^2 + 2x - 4 \), \( g(x) = -3x^2 + 4x + 1 \), and \( h(x) = x^2 - x + 6 \).
Find \( f(x) - (g(x) + h(x)) \). Write your answer in standard form.
questions.hint: First find g(x) + h(x), then subtract the whole result from f(x). The parentheses mean every term of (g+h) gets negated.

questions.question_html:
Simplify. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (4x^3 + 2x - 5) - (x^3 - 3x^2 + x + 2) + (2x^2 - x + 1) \)
questions.hint: Handle the subtraction first: distribute the negative to every term in the second group. Then add the third group. Collect like terms.

questions.question_html: Let \( f(x) = 3x^3 - 5x^2 + 2x - 7 \) and \( g(x) = -x^3 + 4x^2 - x + 3 \). Find \( f(x) - g(x) \). Write your answer in standard form.
questions.hint: Subtract every term of g(x). Watch: -(-x^3) = +x^3 and -(4x^2) = -4x^2.

questions.question_html:
Multiply. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (2x + 3)(x - 4) \)
questions.hint: Use the box method. Top headers: 2x and 3. Left headers: x and -4.

questions.question_html:
Multiply. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (x + 5)(x^2 - 2x + 3) \)
questions.hint: Distribute x across the trinomial, then distribute 5. Combine the x^2 terms.
